name: Ada
tagline: Ada is an AI-powered customer service automation platform that helps businesses deflect support tickets at scale. Its no-code chatbot builder lets teams create intelligent conversational flows without engineering resources. Ada integrates with major CRMs and helpdesks, resolving a large majority of enquiries automatically.
